test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'DIFFRENT' is written as 'EHGESDOS' and 'COMBINE' is written as 'DNNAJMF'. How will 'LETTER' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a2b492c8cb9847fe2e4061d3de90e79d2f1dead3b8270afa2c1d34a93a35ef9.png] 

The Logic Applied here is:

Logic: The Letters which are at even places are Shifted 

One letter backward and the letters which are at odd places

are shifted one letter forward.

DIFFRENT → EHGESDOS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d2ae9fefc6300dd6ad3921380d147e8a0d20bdc19819ac9c246fa1cf2b41ccd.png] 

 

COMBINE → DNNAJMF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/845afdad0cabf2dedd7ca4d868778bf1607e6aeed9644afa3c05705fb83db322.png] 

Similarly,

LETTER → MDUSFQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/042d8df30c9ce53b5bf8a52630a6f81bc9744ae3b3de6366eed0d224586985a9.png] 

Hence, The correct answer is **"Option 1"**
